subject.title: [Feature]: Skip dispatch when message mentions a different account's bot

question: Should Matrix add an opt-in other-configured-account mention suppression gate, and should its public config match the existing Slack/Discord ignoreOtherMentions shape?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds Matrix channel configuration and routing semantics that affect multi-account dispatch, history preservation, and upgrade expectations.

options.title: Add Matrix opt-in gate
options.body: Add a Matrix-owned ignoreOtherMentions-style option that defaults off, skips dispatch when a visible m.mentions target is another configured Matrix account, and preserves skipped messages as pending context.

options.title: Fold into broader routing policy
options.body: Defer this issue until a shared multi-bot routing policy covers Matrix, Discord, Slack, reply targets, and default owners consistently.

options.title: Keep current Matrix controls only
options.body: Leave users on requireMention/allowBots/systemPrompt workarounds and document that Matrix has no non-mentioned-account suppression mode.

recommendation.title: Add Matrix opt-in gate
recommendation.body: Add a Matrix-owned ignoreOtherMentions-style option that defaults off, skips dispatch when a visible m.mentions target is another configured Matrix account, and preserves skipped messages as pending context.

likelyOwner.reason: They have both Matrix mention implementation history and direct context on the related Matrix bot-to-bot visibility discussion.
